reason: Half my crew is on iPhone, so an Android-only crew-run app can't replace the Strava and KakaoTalk setup we already use. On top of that, virtual shoes, gacha pulls and points look like STEPN with the cash-out switched off, and I can't see why I'd care.
objection: It's Android-only, so the crew feature doesn't work for my crew. The shoe and point game also feels like a leftover from a token scheme that could come back or just get shut down.
would_change_my_mind: An iPhone version, plus importing runs from Strava or Garmin so my crew wouldn't have to switch trackers.
